tex_content.html: \begin{example} \end{example}[Cut and conjugate loci of real projective space] 1. ch13:2.4If $M^n=P^n(\mathbb {R})$, obtained by identifying antipodal points of $S^n$, the cut locus of $[p,-p]$ is the subset $P^{n-1}(\mathbb {R})\subset P^n(\mathbb {R})$ obtained by identifying the antipodal points of the "equator" of $p$. The conjugate locus of $[p,-p]$ is $[p,-p]$ itself. \end{example}
